Call sheet

Definition

Call sheet is the dated operational plan that tells cast and crew where to be, when to arrive and what is scheduled. In a controlled workflow, its owner, version and acceptance evidence should be recorded.

Why it matters

This concept helps production teams align production decisions, handoffs and verification without relying on unstated assumptions.
